system: Adversarial engineer reviewing architecture SPEC, not code. No tools, no repository reads. You must either identify a concrete NEW architectural showstopper with reproducible trace or state design is sufficiently specified for offline development and fault-injection. Do not repeat mitigated hypothetical failures without locating remaining gap. Do not claim bug-free implementation.
prompt: NARROW FIFTH REVIEW. Earlier round found three high blockers: 20-item pending-window deadlock, unresolvable stale 200, and regenerating speech after crash/push. Evaluate v5 fixes as a cohesive real Worker-specific protocol. Does any unmitigated high/critical blocker remain? Critique early Git ACK despite mirror down, durable relay journal reconstruction, sequence/generation resync authentication, and old messages falling out of viewer window. Give exact counterexample and minimal correction, deterministic test. If architecture can proceed to offline implementation, say so and identify the code/test work still required. ≤850 words.
context: Real Worker inspected: MAX_QUEUE=50, GET /api/participant/pending returns oldest 20 only, POST /api/participant/ack deletes queue IDs idempotently (user doesn't see ACK); POST /api/allen 202 queued or 429 full; viewer says queued; Durable Object stores single latest feed; POST /api/ingest returns 202 accepted or 200 accepted:false older-cycle/feed/not-newer-boot, using cycle within boot and generated_at timestamps across boot. GET /api/feed latest only, no-cache.

Actual input runner room_participant.py inserts deterministic Allen message based on queue ID before expression, writes local history/discourse/memory and ack IDs. Existing runner pushes Git and calls relay best-effort then queue ACK. Git main authoritative, relay user-visible.

v5: queue-delete ACK now after confirmed Git durable publication only, NOT gated on mirror. Thus first20 drain and next20 accessible even if relay down; processed_inbound_ids idempotent and deterministic input IDs prevent duplication. Mirror delivery separately backed by Git-persisted pending journal and subsequent retry, errors surfaced.

Decision_id H(parent relevant conversational state digest, committed next sequence, action/source IDs, Allen receipt IDs), excluding current output, run ID and unrelated git commits. Stage bytes and ledger with Git commit. No mirror send until Git push succeeds. On push conflict metadata only -> reuse bytes/ID; conversation change -> abandon local D1, recompute D2; duplicate Allen source upstream dedupe. ON RESTART: reconcile Git-published mirror_pending journal before generating any new autonomous beat; reuse exact persisted utterance ID/bytes, never regenerate for already pushed beat.

Mirror stale-200 resync: add separate OIDC-protected resync, verify authoritative Git head/manifest (not trusting arbitrary force), add globally monotonic committed_generation not boot/timestamp based. Enforce trust boundary against older/poisoned snapshots, test skew, replay and revert. Do not treat HTTP 200 stale as success. Keep ordinary ingest until tested.

Feed window loss: add durable source-ID event history/backfill + viewer pagination, or equivalent auditable Git-driven catch-up, instead of relying on last160 latest feed. Restore missing IDs in generation order. Auth and retention tested. Operational backpressure if catch-up capacity exceeded, user 429 when input queue full, never lose already accepted input.

Typed beat health: chosen_silence after successful floor with no expression call is healthy, all-invalid generation is failure; failure ratio monitored independently, Git heartbeats coalesced at <900sec and single orchestration writer, no forced speech.

Experimental isolation: branch/draft PR only, no prod endpoints/token, independent arm state/cache/model quota; validated corpus and action-level metrics, regression/fault tests before canary. No anti-repetition rules, short/legitimate repeats allowed. Plan full doc at docs/research/room-human-conversation-implementation-plan-20261024.md on research branch; you must use only summary, no repo reads.
expected_response: Independent explicit go/no-go on planning readiness, remaining blocker count, failure trace/tests if blockers, no unverifiable 'bug free' claim.
